“Video shows terrifying floods as a typhoon submerges the Philippines in October 2025.”

VERDICT: 🟥 FALSE / MISLEADING
The viral clip isn’t from the Philippines it’s 3 years old footage from Fort Myers Beach, Florida (2022), captured during Hurricane Ian, not Typhoon Bualoi or Tropical Storm Matmo.
